bibl.title: Hymn 1 for the Feast of Epiphany
bibl.author: Ephrem — ܐܦܪܝܡ

noteGrp.note: A hymn for the feast of the Epiphany, the first of fifteen attributed to Ephrem. Its twenty stanzas move from the renewal of heaven and earth through a sequence of Old Testament types of baptism to the opening of the heavens and the voice of the Father at the Jordan. The attribution is disputed.

note.quote: Cœlum renovavit Dominus quia insipientes cœlestia lumina adoraverant; terram renovavit quæ in Adamo marcuerat. Sputo ejus nova creatura facta est. Omnipotens corpora mentesque erexit.
